message.content: {"caption":"A three-stage schematic shows experience acquisition, mixed rollout generation, and incorporation of selected experience into policy training.","description":"The diagram has three numbered panels. (1) “Experience Acquisition”: a robot/agent icon on the left is connected by a right-pointing paper-plane-like arrow labeled “experiences” to another robot/agent icon. A double-headed vertical arrow links this process to a green bar labeled “recall ⊕ rerank ⊕ rewrite.” Below a dashed divider, the “Experience Pool” shows a storage/database icon with branching dotted connectors to three cards: “When exporting data to a file…”, “When interacting with APIs…”, and “When needing to retrieve…”. (2) “Experience-mixed Rollout”: a vertical purple “query” box connects through a branching line to six rows. The top group, “Experience-free Rollouts,” has three rows, each arranged left to right as “null” → “trajectory” → an advantage label and outcome icon: A<0 with a red frowning face and red cross; A>0 with a green smiling face and green check; A<0 with a red frowning face and red cross. The lower group, “Experience-guided Rollouts,” has three rows arranged “exp” → “trajectory” → A>0 with green smiling face and check; “exp” → “trajectory” → A>0 with green smiling face and check; and “exp” → “trajectory” → A<0 with red frowning face and cross. Thus the positive-advantage rows carry checks and the negative-advantage rows carry crosses. (3) “Experience Incorporation”: the upper subsection, “Experience Stripping,” places a purple “query” box beside a diagonally hatched column with four entries—“null”, “null”, “exp”, “exp”—and four corresponding “trajectory” rows labeled A<0, A>0, A>0, and A>0. Yellow star-eyed face icons appear beside the last two A>0 rows; a brace groups the rows, with an ellipsis below indicating more. The lower subsection, “Experience Incorporation,” shows stacked “Training Samples” cards leading right to the condition “If exp & A>0,” then a right-pointing arrow to a robot graphic labeled “Policy Model,” with a flame symbol beside it. Beneath the condition is a yellow face icon and the text “clip higher!”; no additional meaning for the yellow face is specified in the diagram.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
